events.description:
Have you ever prayed and wondered if anyone was listening? If you've wrestled with silence, disappointment, or unanswered prayers - you're not alone.
Daniel prayed for 21 days before discovering that God had heard him from the very first day. This Sunday at 10:00 am, join us at Cowboy Church (Hwy. 65 and Crosstown in Ham Lake) to discover why God's silence doesn't mean God's absence.

events.title: 7th Annual Cowboy Church Power & Prayer Classic Car & Bike Show 2026
events.description:
Rev up your engines and join us for the 7th Annual Cowboy Church Classic Car & Bike Show – Power & Prayer 2026! 
Whether you're showing off your favorite ride or simply coming to enjoy the incredible lineup of classic cars and motorcycles, there's something for everyone. This family-friendly event features food, prizes, a 50/50 raffle, Hot Wheels Car Show and a coloring contest for the kids, and trophies for outstanding entries. Spectating is free, and all makes and models are welcome. Car and Bike entry fee of $15.00 
Start your day by worshiping with us at our 10:00 a.m. service, then stay for an afternoon of fellowship, fun, and horsepower from Noon to 3:00 p.m. We look forward to seeing you there!
